Mechanical properties: Servo-Hydraulic System 100kN (MTS Landmark)
equipment
Institute of Materials Research and Engineering (IMRE)
2 Fusionopolis Way, Innovis, #08-03 Singapore 138634
 What is it? 
 Servo hydraulic testing system with axial/torsional configurations for characterizing quasi-static and fatigue testing on biomaterials, CFRP, Stainless steel, Steels, Titanium and Alloy Aluminium materials. It can test at harsh environment temperatures. 
 Manufacturer: MTS 
 Model Name: Bionix 
 Applications: Testing nanocomposite elastomers that are used in extreme environments. High cyclic fatigue test of Al/Ti alloys and other metals for aerospace industry. Carry out torsion tests on panels, cables for building applications, and on body brace. 
 Instrument Overview: 
 Technical features and specifications: 
 Axial/torsional controlling torsional moments up to ±250 N·m and total rotations of 270 
 Axial/Torsional Load Cells (Force Transducers) 25 kN / 250 N-m Force Rating
 Low Force Axial Load Cell Force Capacity: 5 kN
 Room Temperature Grip and Fixture. Hydraulic Axial/Torsional Wedge Grip. Force Capacity: - Axial: 5.5 Kip (25 kN). - Torsional: 2000 in-lbs (220 N-M). - Adjustable gripping pressure to accommodate a variety of specimen materials. - Temperature Range: -40 to 350 F (-40 to 150 C).
 Environmental Chamber - Temperature Range: -75 C to 315 C. - Interior Dimensions: 286 mm wide, 305 mm deep, 457 mm high.
 LX 500 Laser Extensometer (220 V) - For non-contacting strain measurements. - Measurement Range: 5 - 127 mm. - Resolution: 0.001 mm.
 3 & 4 Point Bend Fixture -10 kN Dynamic Force Capacity, 30 kN Static Force Capacity. -ASTM D-790 Compliant. -ASTM D-2344 Compliant. -Lower Span: 24-152 mm. -Temperature Range: -129°C to 149°C. -Upper Span: 24-76 mm.
 High Temperature Furnace - Temperature ranges from 100°C to 1400°C (Control Point Stability ±1°C) - Hot Zone 50 x 50 x 50mm (W x D x H)
 HCF performance at cycling test of 60Hz with a load force of 20kN, the displacement amplitude should achieve at least +/-0.2 mm or larger. => The Performance Curve Displacement amplitude is 1.5mm. At cycling test of 100Hz with a load force of 6kN, the displacement amplitude should achieve at least +/-0.4 mm or larger. => The Performance Curve Displacement amplitude is 0.9mm
 Charges:
 NA
 Instrument Manufacturer URL: https://corp.mts.com/home/
 Detailed Specifications: 
 https://corp.mts.com/cs/groups/public/documents/library/dev_003992.pdf
